howItWorks.title: How Ataa Platform Works
howItWorks.subtitle: The journey of giving from field verification to transparent delivery
howItWorks.step1Desc: Certified field researchers visit each family, verify official documentation, and assess urgent needs while preserving dignity.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Needs (medical bills, rent, tuition) are published with exact financial targets, keeping all private data confidential.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Donors pay via local/international payment methods, receiving an official receipt and live tracking reference ID.

trust.title: Why Donors & Families Trust Us
trust.subtitle: Uncompromising standards of financial integrity and beneficiary dignity
trust.point1Desc: No case is listed without verifying income records, medical diagnosis, and official contracts.
trust.point2Desc: Family identities remain protected; financial transactions use enterprise-grade encryption.
trust.point3Desc: Track your donation step-by-step from pending to processing and service fulfillment.
trust.point4Desc: Family donations go 100% to beneficiaries; platform cloud and hosting fees are funded separately.
